structure.note: Ordinary (voting) and non-voting preferred shares. Of the votes on the 295,089,818 ordinary shares at December 31, 2025, Porsche Automobil Holding SE held 53.3%, the State of Lower Saxony 20.0% and Qatar Holding LLC 17.0%; 9.7% were free float. The annual report states that Hans Michel Piëch, Ferdinand Oliver Porsche and Wolfgang Porsche, 'together with other family shareholders, are indirectly controlling shareholders of Porsche Automobil Holding SE, which is the largest single shareholder of Volkswagen AG.' Under Article 11(1) of the Articles of Association, Lower Saxony may appoint two Supervisory Board members while it holds at least 15% of the ordinary shares.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, from Volkswagen's Annual Report 2025 and Consolidated Financial Statements 2025 PDFs on uploads.vw-mms.de, the document host linked from volkswagen-group.com/en/financial-reports (the consolidated statements file is named '...as-of-december-31-2023-en.pdf' on the host, but its contents are the 2025 statements). EUR, converted exactly from € millions. LEADER: Herbert Diess left the Board of Management on August 31, 2022; the 2025 report says his contract ran until October 24, 2025 and shows his 2025 remuneration, but gives no shareholding for him, so status is 'no-reported-stake'. HOLDERS: percentages are of subscribed capital (ordinary plus preferred), as the chart states, so they are economic. The Porsche and Piëch families' interest is held through Porsche SE; it is not listed separately, to avoid double counting, and the report gives no family look-through percentage. The chart's other categories (foreign institutional investors 19.4%, private shareholders/others 24.4%, German institutional investors 2.1%) are groups, not holders, so they are not listed. DIVIDENDS: €3,171 million to Volkswagen AG shareholders (retained-earnings column of the statement of changes in equity; the notes say the same €3,171 million was paid to Volkswagen AG shareholders); the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' of €4,460 million also includes €664 million to hybrid capital investors and €625 million to non-controlling interests, both excluded. BUYBACKS: 0; no purchases of own shares appear in the cash-flow statement or statement of changes in equity. STOCK COMP: null. Volkswagen's share-based payment consists only of cash-settled performance share plans based on the preferred share price; no shares are granted, and the notes give expenses by plan but no total, so no figure is recorded rather than summing. GEOGRAPHY: five regions as reported; the 'Hedges sales revenue' column (€238 million) is omitted, so segments sum to €321,674 million against the €321,913 million total.
